text:
Nothing documented happened to Paul McCartney on November 9, 1966: he was not in a car crash and did not die. That date is the origin of the "Paul is dead" hoax, which claimed he died in a car crash that day and was replaced by a lookalike, so the note's options ("He was in a car crash" or "He died") describe the rumour, not real events. My earlier mention of a motorcycle crash on that date was wrong; the real moped accident I was thinking of is usually dated to December 1965.

CONFIDENCE: 85
